WITH old AS (
    SELECT * FROM research_watch_scan_formula_samples
    WHERE evaluation_version='watch-scan-formulas-v4-asset-context' AND status='READY'
), new AS (
    SELECT s.*,m.decision_map FROM research_watch_scan_formula_samples s
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT jsonb_object_agg((value->>'candidate_key')||'|'||(value->>'base_direction'),value) AS decision_map
        FROM jsonb_array_elements(s.payload->'evaluations')) m
    WHERE evaluation_version='watch-scan-formulas-v5-score-change' AND status='READY'
), pairs AS (
    SELECT o.consumer_version,o.snapshot_set_id,o.symbol,o.payload AS old_payload,
        n.payload AS new_payload,n.decision_map,n.snapshot_set_id IS NOT NULL AS new_present
    FROM old o LEFT JOIN new n USING(consumer_version,snapshot_set_id,symbol)
), decisions AS (
    SELECT p.snapshot_set_id,p.symbol,o.value AS old_decision,p.decision_map->((o.value->>'candidate_key')||'|'||(o.value->>'base_direction')) AS new_decision
    FROM pairs p CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(p.old_payload->'evaluations') o(value)
), prior_features AS (
    SELECT p.snapshot_set_id,p.symbol,b.base,k.key,k.value AS old_value,
        p.new_payload->'features_by_direction'->b.base->block.kind->k.key AS new_value
    FROM pairs p CROSS JOIN (VALUES('LONG'),('SHORT')) b(base)
    CROSS JOIN (VALUES('features'),('unavailable_features')) block(kind)
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(p.old_payload->'features_by_direction'->b.base->block.kind) k
), source_binding AS (
    SELECT n.*,i.bundle_sha256,i.parent_payload_sha256,
        n.payload->'asset_context_provenance' AS own_context
    FROM new n JOIN research_watch_scan_intakes i USING(consumer_version,snapshot_set_id)
), shared AS (
    SELECT snapshot_set_id,count(DISTINCT payload->'btc_context_provenance') AS btc_contexts
    FROM new GROUP BY snapshot_set_id
), catalog AS (
    SELECT o.candidate_key AS old_key,n.candidate_key AS new_key,o.definition AS old_definition,
        n.definition AS new_definition,o.definition_sha256 AS old_hash,n.definition_sha256 AS new_hash,
        o.orientation AS old_orientation,n.orientation AS new_orientation,
        o.supported AS old_supported,n.supported AS new_supported
    FROM (SELECT * FROM research_watch_scan_formula_catalog WHERE evaluation_version='watch-scan-formulas-v4-asset-context') o
    FULL JOIN (SELECT * FROM research_watch_scan_formula_catalog WHERE evaluation_version='watch-scan-formulas-v5-score-change') n
    USING(candidate_key)
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'old_ready_samples',(SELECT count(*) FROM old),
    'old_samples_missing_v5',(SELECT count(*) FROM pairs WHERE NOT new_present),
    'v5_samples_without_v4',(SELECT count(*) FROM new n LEFT JOIN old o USING(consumer_version,snapshot_set_id,symbol) WHERE o.snapshot_set_id IS NULL),
    'old_decisions_checked',(SELECT count(*) FROM decisions),
    'old_decision_mismatches',(SELECT count(*) FROM decisions WHERE old_decision IS DISTINCT FROM new_decision),
    'old_feature_or_missing_reason_mismatches',(SELECT count(*) FROM prior_features WHERE old_value IS DISTINCT FROM new_value),
    'frozen_asset_context_mismatches',(SELECT count(*) FROM pairs WHERE old_payload->'asset_context_provenance' IS DISTINCT FROM new_payload->'asset_context_provenance'),
    'frozen_btc_context_mismatches',(SELECT count(*) FROM pairs WHERE old_payload->'btc_context_provenance' IS DISTINCT FROM new_payload->'btc_context_provenance'),
    'split_btc_context_scans',(SELECT count(*) FROM shared WHERE btc_contexts<>1),
    'source_or_context_binding_mismatches',(SELECT count(*) FROM source_binding WHERE
        payload->>'bundle_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM bundle_sha256 OR payload->>'parent_payload_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM parent_payload_sha256
        OR own_context->>'symbol' IS DISTINCT FROM symbol
        OR own_context->>'consumer_version' IS DISTINCT FROM consumer_version
        OR (own_context->>'snapshot_set_id')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM snapshot_set_id
        OR own_context->>'bundle_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM bundle_sha256
        OR own_context->>'parent_payload_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM parent_payload_sha256
        OR (own_context->>'usable_from_utc')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM usable_from_utc
        OR (own_context->>'cutoff_utc')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM date_trunc('minute',usable_from_utc)
        OR own_context->>'btc_context_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM payload#>>'{btc_context_provenance,context_sha256}'),
    'btc_own_1h_4h_window_mismatches',(SELECT count(*) FROM new CROSS JOIN (VALUES('1h'),('4h')) w(name)
        WHERE symbol='BTC' AND payload->'asset_context_provenance'->'windows'->w.name
            IS DISTINCT FROM payload->'btc_context_provenance'->'windows'->w.name),
    'catalog_definition_or_orientation_mismatches',(SELECT count(*) FROM catalog WHERE old_key IS NULL OR new_key IS NULL
        OR old_definition IS DISTINCT FROM new_definition OR old_hash IS DISTINCT FROM new_hash OR old_orientation IS DISTINCT FROM new_orientation),
    'previously_supported_now_unsupported',(SELECT count(*) FROM catalog WHERE old_supported AND NOT new_supported),
    'newly_supported_definitions',(SELECT count(*) FROM catalog WHERE NOT old_supported AND new_supported),
    'decision_mismatch_examples',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) FROM (SELECT * FROM decisions WHERE old_decision IS DISTINCT FROM new_decision LIMIT 10) x)) AS verification;
sql.selector-and-scores:
WITH current_samples AS (
    SELECT s.consumer_version,s.snapshot_set_id,s.symbol,s.payload,s.updated_at_utc,
        i.watch_scan_id,i.usable_from_utc,i.observed_at_utc,i.source_available_at_utc,i.source_created_at_utc,
        i.bundle_sha256,i.parent_payload_sha256,s.payload->'score_change_context_provenance' AS context,
        s.consumer_version||':'||s.snapshot_set_id||':'||s.symbol AS point_id
    FROM research_watch_scan_formula_samples s JOIN research_watch_scan_intakes i USING(consumer_version,snapshot_set_id)
    WHERE s.evaluation_version='watch-scan-formulas-v5-score-change' AND s.status='READY'
), scans AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT consumer_version,snapshot_set_id,watch_scan_id,usable_from_utc,observed_at_utc
    FROM current_samples
), candidate_metadata AS (
    SELECT s.consumer_version,s.snapshot_set_id,p.snapshot_set_id AS prior_id,p.usable_from_utc,
        p.observed_at_utc,p.watch_scan_id,p.ingested_at_utc,
        max(p.usable_from_utc) OVER(PARTITION BY s.consumer_version,s.snapshot_set_id) AS latest_usable
    FROM scans s LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT i.snapshot_set_id,i.usable_from_utc,i.observed_at_utc,i.watch_scan_id,i.ingested_at_utc
        FROM research_watch_scan_intakes i
        WHERE i.consumer_version=s.consumer_version AND i.intake_status='ACCEPTED'
            AND i.watch_scan_id<>s.watch_scan_id AND i.observed_at_utc<s.observed_at_utc
            AND i.usable_from_utc>=s.usable_from_utc-interval '30 minutes' AND i.usable_from_utc<s.usable_from_utc
        ORDER BY i.usable_from_utc DESC,i.snapshot_set_id LIMIT 2
    ) p ON true
), selection AS (
    SELECT consumer_version,snapshot_set_id,
        count(prior_id) FILTER(WHERE usable_from_utc=latest_usable) AS latest_candidates,
        COALESCE(array_agg(prior_id ORDER BY prior_id) FILTER(WHERE usable_from_utc=latest_usable),'{}'::bigint[]) AS expected_ids,
        CASE WHEN count(prior_id)=0 THEN 'NO_PREDECESSOR'
            WHEN count(prior_id) FILTER(WHERE usable_from_utc=latest_usable)>1 THEN 'AMBIGUOUS' ELSE 'SELECTED' END AS expected_selection,
        CASE WHEN count(prior_id) FILTER(WHERE usable_from_utc=latest_usable)=1
            THEN min(prior_id) FILTER(WHERE usable_from_utc=latest_usable) END AS expected_prior_id,
        max(ingested_at_utc) FILTER(WHERE usable_from_utc=latest_usable) AS latest_candidate_admission
    FROM candidate_metadata GROUP BY consumer_version,snapshot_set_id
), required_ids AS (
    SELECT consumer_version,snapshot_set_id FROM scans
    UNION SELECT consumer_version,unnest(expected_ids) AS snapshot_set_id FROM selection
), observations AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT o.consumer_version,o.snapshot_set_id,o.symbol,o.watch_scan_id,o.usable_from_utc,o.observed_at_utc,
        o.source_available_at_utc,o.source_created_at_utc,o.bundle_sha256,o.parent_payload_sha256,
        o.models,o.sources,o.source_time_errors
    FROM research_watch_scan_observations o JOIN required_ids r USING(consumer_version,snapshot_set_id)
), chosen AS (
    SELECT s.*,p.expected_ids,p.expected_prior_id,p.expected_selection,p.latest_candidate_admission,
        COALESCE((SELECT array_agg((value->>'snapshot_set_id')::bigint ORDER BY (value->>'snapshot_set_id')::bigint)
            FROM jsonb_array_elements(s.context->'predecessors')),'{}'::bigint[]) AS actual_ids
    FROM current_samples s JOIN selection p USING(consumer_version,snapshot_set_id)
), points AS (
    SELECT c.point_id,phase.name AS phase,b.base,m.family,m.source_name,o.observed_at_utc,
        o.models->m.module_name AS module,o.sources,COALESCE(o.source_time_errors,'[]'::jsonb) AS source_time_errors
    FROM chosen c CROSS JOIN (VALUES('current'),('prior')) phase(name)
    CROSS JOIN (VALUES('LONG'),('SHORT')) b(base)
    CROSS JOIN (VALUES('price_oi','positioning','positioning'),('futures_cvd','futures_flow','futures'),
        ('spot_cvd','spot_flow','spot')) m(family,module_name,source_name)
    LEFT JOIN observations o ON o.consumer_version=c.consumer_version AND o.symbol=c.symbol
        AND o.snapshot_set_id=CASE WHEN phase.name='current' THEN c.snapshot_set_id ELSE c.expected_prior_id END
),

-- Independent source-contract and aligned-score checks; assembled with selector
-- and result comparisons once the new provenance schema is finalized.
-- Input CTE points must provide point_id, phase, base, family, source_name,
-- observed_at_utc, module, sources and source_time_errors.
source_points AS (
    SELECT p.*,p.sources->p.source_name AS source,
        CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p.module->'score')='number'
            AND (p.module->>'score')::numeric BETWEEN -100 AND 100
            THEN (p.module->>'score')::float8 END AS raw_score,
        upper(COALESCE(p.module->>'direction','')) AS raw_direction
    FROM points p
), score_points AS (
    SELECT s.*,CASE
        WHEN raw_direction IN ('LONG','BUY','BULLISH','UP') THEN 'LONG'
        WHEN raw_direction IN ('SHORT','SELL','BEARISH','DOWN') THEN 'SHORT'
        WHEN raw_direction IN ('','NEUTRAL') THEN
            CASE WHEN raw_score>0 THEN 'LONG' WHEN raw_score<0 THEN 'SHORT' ELSE 'NEUTRAL' END
        END AS model_direction,
        jsonb_typeof(module)='object' AND module->'available'='true'::jsonb
            AND module->>'capture_status'='AVAILABLE' AND raw_score IS NOT NULL
            AND (module->'direction' IS NULL OR module->'direction'='null'::jsonb OR jsonb_typeof(module->'direction')='string')
            AS module_available,
        jsonb_typeof(source)='object' AND jsonb_typeof(source->'window_references')='object'
            AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(source_time_errors) e(error)
                WHERE e.error LIKE source_name||'/%'
                    OR (source_name IN ('futures','spot') AND e.error LIKE 'derivatives/observed:%'))
            AS source_shape_valid
    FROM source_points s
), window_points AS (
    SELECT s.point_id,s.phase,s.base,s.family,s.source_name,s.observed_at_utc,s.source,
        w.key AS window_name,w.value AS window_data
    FROM score_points s CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(source->'window_references')='object'
        THEN source->'window_references' ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) w
), timestamp_points AS (
    SELECT point_id,phase,base,family,observed_at_utc,
        source->>'price_fetched_at' AS value,true AS required
    FROM score_points WHERE source_name='positioning'
    UNION ALL SELECT point_id,phase,base,family,observed_at_utc,source->>'oi_fetched_at',true
    FROM score_points WHERE source_name='positioning'
    UNION ALL SELECT point_id,phase,base,family,observed_at_utc,source#>>'{quality,candle_close}',true
    FROM score_points WHERE source_name IN ('futures','spot')
    UNION ALL SELECT point_id,phase,base,family,observed_at_utc,sources#>>'{timing_observation,cvd_observed_at_utc}',true
    FROM score_points WHERE source_name IN ('futures','spot')
    UNION ALL SELECT point_id,phase,base,family,observed_at_utc,window_data->>'latest_time',
        window_data->'available'='true'::jsonb AND source_name<>'positioning' FROM window_points
    UNION ALL SELECT point_id,phase,base,family,observed_at_utc,window_data->>'reference_time',
        window_data->'available'='true'::jsonb FROM window_points
    UNION ALL SELECT point_id,phase,base,family,observed_at_utc,window_data->>'reference_target_time',false FROM window_points
    UNION ALL SELECT point_id,phase,base,family,observed_at_utc,window_data->>'target_time',false FROM window_points
), timestamp_checks AS (
    SELECT point_id,phase,base,family,bool_and(CASE
        WHEN value IS NULL OR value='' THEN NOT required
        WHEN NOT pg_input_is_valid(value,'timestamptz') THEN false
        ELSE value::timestamptz<=observed_at_utc END) AS valid_times
    FROM timestamp_points GROUP BY point_id,phase,base,family
), window_checks AS (
    SELECT point_id,phase,base,family,bool_and(
        jsonb_typeof(window_data)='object' AND jsonb_typeof(window_data->'available') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'boolean'
        AND CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid(window_data->>'reference_time','timestamptz')
            AND pg_input_is_valid(window_data->>'latest_time','timestamptz')
            THEN (window_data->>'reference_time')::timestamptz<=(window_data->>'latest_time')::timestamptz ELSE true END
        AND CASE WHEN source_name='positioning' AND pg_input_is_valid(window_data->>'reference_time','timestamptz')
            AND pg_input_is_valid(source->>'price_fetched_at','timestamptz')
            AND pg_input_is_valid(source->>'oi_fetched_at','timestamptz')
            THEN (window_data->>'reference_time')::timestamptz<=least((source->>'price_fetched_at')::timestamptz,
                (source->>'oi_fetched_at')::timestamptz) ELSE true END
        ) AS valid_windows
    FROM window_points GROUP BY point_id,phase,base,family
), validated_scores AS (
    SELECT s.*,module_available AND model_direction IS NOT NULL AND source_shape_valid
        AND t.valid_times IS TRUE AND COALESCE(w.valid_windows,true) AS valid_score,
        CASE WHEN model_direction=base THEN abs(raw_score) ELSE -abs(raw_score) END AS aligned_score
    FROM score_points s LEFT JOIN timestamp_checks t USING(point_id,phase,base,family)
    LEFT JOIN window_checks w USING(point_id,phase,base,family)
)

, deltas AS (
    SELECT s.*,c.base,c.family,c.valid_score IS TRUE AS current_valid,p.valid_score IS TRUE AS prior_valid,
        c.aligned_score AS raw_current_aligned,p.aligned_score AS raw_prior_aligned,
        s.expected_selection='SELECTED' AND c.valid_score IS TRUE AND p.valid_score IS TRUE AS expected_known,
        c.aligned_score-p.aligned_score AS raw_delta,
        'sequence.30m.'||c.family||'.score_change' AS feature,
        s.payload->'features_by_direction'->c.base->'features' AS feature_values,
        s.payload->'features_by_direction'->c.base->'unavailable_features' AS missing_values
    FROM chosen s JOIN validated_scores c ON c.point_id=s.point_id AND c.phase='current'
    JOIN validated_scores p ON p.point_id=c.point_id AND p.base=c.base AND p.family=c.family AND p.phase='prior'
), checks AS (
    SELECT d.*,
        CASE WHEN expected_known THEN
            CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(feature_values->feature)='number'
                THEN abs((feature_values->>feature)::float8-raw_delta)>1e-9 ELSE true END
            ELSE feature_values ? feature OR COALESCE(jsonb_array_length(missing_values->feature),0)=0 END AS delta_error,
        feature_values->feature IS DISTINCT FROM context->'features_by_direction'->base->feature
            OR missing_values->feature IS DISTINCT FROM context->'unavailable_features_by_direction'->base->feature AS projection_error,
        expected_selection='NO_PREDECESSOR' AND NOT COALESCE((missing_values->feature) ? 'NO_CAUSAL_PREDECESSOR_IN_30M',false)
            OR expected_selection='AMBIGUOUS' AND NOT COALESCE((missing_values->feature) ? 'AMBIGUOUS_LATEST_PREDECESSOR_TIMESTAMP',false)
            AS expected_unknown_reason_error,
        CASE WHEN current_valid THEN context->'current_model_evidence'->base->'features'->(family||'.aligned_score')
                IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(raw_current_aligned)
            ELSE context->'current_model_evidence'->base->'features' ? (family||'.aligned_score') END AS current_proof_error,
        CASE WHEN expected_selection<>'SELECTED' THEN false WHEN prior_valid
            THEN context->'predecessors'->0->'model_evidence'->base->'features'->(family||'.aligned_score')
                IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(raw_prior_aligned)
            ELSE context->'predecessors'->0->'model_evidence'->base->'features' ? (family||'.aligned_score') END AS prior_proof_error
    FROM deltas d
), predecessor_bindings AS (
    SELECT s.point_id,p.value AS proof,o.*,
        p.value->'observation' AS captured
    FROM chosen s CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(s.context->'predecessors') p
    LEFT JOIN observations o ON o.consumer_version=s.consumer_version AND o.symbol=s.symbol
        AND o.snapshot_set_id=(p.value->>'snapshot_set_id')::bigint
), summary AS (
    SELECT expected_selection,count(DISTINCT point_id) AS coin_samples,count(*) AS directional_feature_cells,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE expected_known) AS known,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT expected_known) AS unknown,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT current_valid) AS current_model_unavailable,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE expected_selection='SELECTED' AND NOT prior_valid) AS nearest_prior_model_unavailable,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE delta_error OR projection_error OR expected_unknown_reason_error OR current_proof_error OR prior_proof_error) AS errors
    FROM checks GROUP BY expected_selection
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'checked_at_utc',clock_timestamp(),
    'coin_samples',(SELECT count(*) FROM chosen),
    'directional_score_change_cells',(SELECT count(*) FROM checks),
    'selector_mismatches',(SELECT count(*) FROM chosen WHERE actual_ids IS DISTINCT FROM expected_ids OR context->>'selection_status' IS DISTINCT FROM expected_selection),
    'selector_mismatches_with_later_intake_admission',(SELECT count(*) FROM chosen WHERE latest_candidate_admission>updated_at_utc
        AND (actual_ids IS DISTINCT FROM expected_ids OR context->>'selection_status' IS DISTINCT FROM expected_selection)),
    'raw_delta_errors',(SELECT count(*) FROM checks WHERE delta_error),
    'projection_errors',(SELECT count(*) FROM checks WHERE projection_error),
    'expected_unknown_reason_errors',(SELECT count(*) FROM checks WHERE expected_unknown_reason_error),
    'raw_current_evidence_errors',(SELECT count(*) FROM checks WHERE current_proof_error),
    'raw_prior_evidence_errors',(SELECT count(*) FROM checks WHERE prior_proof_error),
    'current_source_binding_errors',(SELECT count(*) FROM chosen WHERE
        context->>'symbol' IS DISTINCT FROM symbol OR context->>'watch_scan_id' IS DISTINCT FROM watch_scan_id
        OR context->>'consumer_version' IS DISTINCT FROM consumer_version
        OR (context->>'snapshot_set_id')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM snapshot_set_id
        OR context->>'bundle_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM bundle_sha256 OR context->>'parent_payload_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM parent_payload_sha256
        OR (context->>'usable_from_utc')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM usable_from_utc
        OR (context->>'observed_at_utc')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM observed_at_utc
        OR (context->>'source_available_at_utc')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM source_available_at_utc
        OR (context->>'source_created_at_utc')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM source_created_at_utc
        OR (context->>'window_start_utc')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM usable_from_utc-interval '30 minutes'
        OR (context->>'window_end_exclusive_utc')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM usable_from_utc
        OR context->>'selection_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'watch-latest-earlier-distinct-scan-30m-no-skip-v1'),
    'predecessor_source_binding_errors',(SELECT count(*) FROM predecessor_bindings WHERE snapshot_set_id IS NULL
        OR (captured->>'snapshot_set_id')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM snapshot_set_id OR captured->>'symbol' IS DISTINCT FROM symbol
        OR captured->>'watch_scan_id' IS DISTINCT FROM watch_scan_id
        OR captured->>'bundle_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM bundle_sha256 OR captured->>'parent_payload_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM parent_payload_sha256
        OR (captured->>'usable_from_utc')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM usable_from_utc
        OR (captured->>'observed_at_utc')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM observed_at_utc
        OR (captured->>'source_available_at_utc')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM source_available_at_utc
        OR (captured->>'source_created_at_utc')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM source_created_at_utc
        OR captured->'models' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('positioning',models->'positioning','futures_flow',models->'futures_flow','spot_flow',models->'spot_flow')
        OR captured->'sources' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('positioning',sources->'positioning','futures',sources->'futures','spot',sources->'spot','timing_observation',sources->'timing_observation')
        OR captured->'source_time_errors' IS DISTINCT FROM source_time_errors),
    'by_selection',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY expected_selection) FROM summary r),
    'mismatch_examples',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e)) FROM (SELECT snapshot_set_id,symbol,base,family,expected_selection,
        expected_known,raw_current_aligned,raw_prior_aligned,raw_delta,feature_values->feature AS actual_delta,
        missing_values->feature AS reasons,delta_error,projection_error,current_proof_error,prior_proof_error
        FROM checks WHERE delta_error OR projection_error OR expected_unknown_reason_error OR current_proof_error OR prior_proof_error LIMIT 12) e)
) AS verification;
sql.state:
WITH current_samples AS (
    SELECT * FROM research_watch_scan_formula_samples
    WHERE evaluation_version='watch-scan-formulas-v5-score-change'
), accepted AS (
    SELECT * FROM research_watch_scan_intakes
    WHERE consumer_version='watch-all-scan-intake-v1' AND intake_status='ACCEPTED'
), incomplete AS (
    SELECT i.snapshot_set_id,coin.symbol,s.status
    FROM accepted i CROSS JOIN unnest(ARRAY['BTC','ETH','SOL','BNB','XRP','DOGE','ZEC','HYPE']) coin(symbol)
    LEFT JOIN current_samples s ON s.consumer_version=i.consumer_version
        AND s.snapshot_set_id=i.snapshot_set_id AND s.symbol=coin.symbol
    WHERE s.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'READY'
), catalogs AS (
    SELECT evaluation_version,count(*) AS definitions,count(*) FILTER(WHERE supported) AS supported,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT supported) AS unsupported
    FROM research_watch_scan_formula_catalog GROUP BY evaluation_version
), evals AS (
    SELECT evaluation_version,count(*) AS decisions,count(DISTINCT candidate_key) AS candidates,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE match_status='MATCH') AS matched,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE match_status='NO_MATCH') AS controls,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE match_status='UNKNOWN') AS unknown,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE qualifies_as_prospective_formula_evidence) AS prospective
    FROM research_watch_scan_formula_evaluations GROUP BY evaluation_version
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'checked_at_utc',clock_timestamp(),
    'runtime',(SELECT to_jsonb(r) FROM research_watch_scan_formula_runtime r WHERE singleton=true),
    'catalogs',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c) ORDER BY evaluation_version) FROM catalogs c),
    'accepted_scans',(SELECT count(*) FROM accepted),
    'expected_coin_samples',(SELECT count(*)*8 FROM accepted),
    'missing_or_pending_coin_samples',(SELECT count(*) FROM incomplete),
    'v5_samples',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('all',count(*),'ready',count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='READY'),
        'waiting',count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='WAITING'),'errors',count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='ERROR'),
        'scans',count(DISTINCT snapshot_set_id),'symbols',count(DISTINCT symbol),
        'bad_decision_coverage',count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='READY' AND jsonb_array_length(payload->'evaluations') IS DISTINCT FROM 340),
        'latest_usable_utc',max(usable_from_utc)) FROM current_samples),
    'current_evaluations',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e)) FROM evals e),
    'independent_live_btc_waves',(SELECT count(DISTINCT m.payload#>>'{membership,btc_parent_movement_id}')
        FROM research_watch_scan_measurements m JOIN accepted i USING(consumer_version,snapshot_set_id)
        WHERE m.measurement_version='watch-scan-measurements-v1'
            AND m.payload#>>'{membership,membership_status}'='LIVE'
            AND m.payload#>>'{membership,episode_policy_version}'='btc-parent-close-reversal-200bps-v1'),
    'version_cursor',(SELECT to_jsonb(st) FROM research_watch_scan_formula_state st
        WHERE evaluation_version='watch-scan-formulas-v5-score-change')) AS verification;
